Name: PPJA - Fresh Meat_An 'Alternative' Butcher Mod
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZWdgCxZ.png[/img]﻿﻿

The butcher mod (now animal husbandry) is cool, but I can't stand to part with my precious pigs. Yet, meat is awful tempting! So here we are! Best of both worlds, with another port. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/asuQXFm.png[/img]

Adds 20 new meat crops and trees into the game along with new recipes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png[/img]﻿

If you would like to contribute to the project, we welcome pull requests on our [url=https://github.com/paradigmnomad/PPJA]Github repo[/url]﻿!  You may also submit ideas or translations there.

Tired of all of the recipes being shoved into the normal cooking menu? Check out Kaya's wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6305]CCS Kitchen Station Set[/url]﻿.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cVevYNe.png[/img]﻿

﻿See MouseyPounds database!
﻿
[url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/index.html]L I N K[/url][url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/index.html][/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

﻿- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]Fruits & Veggies[/url][b]﻿﻿
[/b]- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6069]Multi Yield Crops[/url]﻿
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]

- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5099]BugNet[/url]﻿ (optional, for the ability to producer different types of critter meat)
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿ (optional, for animated crops)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]﻿

Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, SpaceCore, Fruits and Veggies, Mail Framework Mod, Content Patcher, Multi Yield Crops, Producer Framework Mod, and any optional requirements..
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 4 files included in the download:

[JA] Fresh Meat
[MFM] Fresh Meat
[MYC] Fresh meat
[PFM] Fresh Meat

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿
﻿
- Delete every existing seed, harvested crop, and plant excluding shops and letters.
- Remove the corresponding folders.

[color=#ff7700][b]If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.[/b][/color][/left]
